search_text: published ZDI-14-229 ZDI-CAN-2083 Hewlett-Packard Universal CMDB mam-collectors Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2014-07-09 CVE-2014-2615 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-2615 7.5 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Universal CMDB'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Universal CMDB. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the mam-collectors servlet. The issue lies in the ability to download arbitrary files. A remote attacker can abuse this to disclose the credentials store that could result in remote code under the context of the process. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://h20566.www2.hp.com/portal/site/hpsc/public/kb/docDisplay/?docId=emr_na-c04357076 ['2014-03-07 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2014-07-09 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Mike Arnold (Bruk0ut) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-14-229/
